cut: Coxon 7, v1 (owner approved the pitch, 18 Oct) — one question: what is the industry getting ready?
argument: AI insiders reportedly expect a disaster within a year, and the industry's reported plan is to shape the rules afterwards. The kill switch on that list comes after; until then, the sticky note.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: AI insiders reportedly expect / a major AI disaster within a year. / What are they [getting ready]?
text.fi: Tekoälyalan sisäpiiri odottaa / raporttien mukaan suurta / tekoälykatastrofia vuoden sisällä. / Mihin he [valmistautuvat]?
text.ja: AI業界の 内部者は 1年以内の / 大規模な AI災害を 予想して いると 報じられた。 / 彼らは 何を [準備して] いる？

captions.source: Axios, 9 Oct 2026 (scoop): many AI industry insiders expect a large-scale AI event within six to twelve months. An insider forecast, not a company timeline; OpenAI says its scenarios are 'not treated as inevitable'. Confirmed across Decrypt, Gizmodo, Digital Trends, Inc42 (research-governance.md §4).

text.en: Most likely a [cyberattack]: / banks, internet, power, water.
text.ja: 最も ありそうなのは [サイバー攻撃]。 / 銀行、 ネット、 電気、 水道。

captions.source: Axios via Decrypt and Gizmodo: most likely a cyberattack that cuts off financial services, internet connectivity, or power and water.

text.en: Their reported plan: / brief Congress, and shape / the rules that come [after].
text.fi: Raportoitu suunnitelma: / briifata kongressia ja muokata / säännöt, jotka tulevat [jälkeen].
text.ja: 報じられた 計画は 議会への 説明と、 / [その後に] できる ルール作り。

captions.source: Axios: the planning focuses on educating members of Congress; executives believe regulation has no chance of passing now and want to shape the rules leaders reach for after a first major event.

text.en: One rule on the list: / a required [kill switch].
text.ja: リストの ルールの 一つは / 義務化された [キルスイッチ]。

captions.source: Axios, as repeated by several outlets: among the proposals with bipartisan support and some industry buy-in, a required kill switch on advanced AI; experts question whether it is workable. CHECK against the Axios text before air (research-governance.md §4, refresh).

text.en: The off switch: [the day after]. / Until then: the sticky note.
text.fi: Katkaisin tulee [vasta jälkeenpäin]. / Siihen asti: muistilappu.
text.ja: 停止スイッチは [その翌日]。 / それまでは 付箋。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image: the kill switch behind glass marked OPEN THE DAY AFTER, and on the glass the sticky note from Kill Switch (Coxon 6).

podium.why: the podium's front panel: the plan, shown; English in every master, the caption carries it

box.en: IN CASE OF DISASTER / OPEN THE DAY AFTER
box.why: the emergency box's plate: the punchline, as a thing

note.why: the exact sticky note from Kill Switch (Coxon 6): the callback

post.en: AI insiders reportedly expect a major AI disaster within a year, most likely a cyberattack on banks, internet, power or water. The industry's reported plan: brief Congress and shape the rules that come after. One of them: a required kill switch. #AI #AIsafety
post.fi: Tekoälyalan sisäpiiri odottaa raporttien mukaan suurta tekoälykatastrofia vuoden sisällä, todennäköisimmin kyberhyökkäystä pankkeihin, nettiin, sähköön tai veteen. Alan suunnitelma: briifata kongressia ja muokata säännöt, jotka tulevat jälkeen. Yksi niistä: pakollinen hätäkatkaisin.
post.ja: AI業界の内部者は1年以内の大規模なAI災害を予想していると報じられた。最も可能性が高いのは銀行・ネット・電気・水道へのサイバー攻撃。業界の計画は議会への説明と、その後のルール作り。その一つが義務化されたキルスイッチ。
